messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed our narrow-route fallback shim is causing quota attribution to show as "unknown" in the console when requests fall back to a variant. Anyone else running into this?
rob: Saw a spike yesterday during canary. Can you paste repro steps?
maya: Repro: send request with header `X-RD-Route: tenant-foo` then force capacity so it falls back to `fast-small-quant`. Console shows quotas attributed to "fallback" instead of tenant. Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.screens/abc123
ellie: Yikes — that's going to mess up billing dashboards. Is the route header preserved across the proxy chain?
sanjay: The shim intentionally drops route meta for variant fallbacks to avoid leaking some internal tags. That was the original design, but agree it breaks attribution.
rob: So we have two paths: preserve the header (easy) or synthesize attribution server-side from the original request (more work, but avoids header propagation).
maya: Preserving might interact badly with policy checks further downstream. We need to confirm with policy agent.
kevin: Implementation idea: preserve a minimal route id (hashed) instead of full route metadata, then use a backend lookup to map hash -> tenant. SDKs can opt-in to enable preservation. Flag example: `X-RD-Preserve-Route: true`
maya: Example curl: `curl -sS api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H "X-RD-Route: tenant-foo" -H "X-RD-Preserve-Route: true" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
devex-bot: note — python-sdk v1.8.0 will include a helper for `preserve_route_fallback` (opt-in). @devex-team
ellie: We should avoid changing defaults. Make this opt-in (SDK flag + env var) and add a console rollout toggle to enable preserved-attribution per org.
sanjay: Also: telemetry contract update needed. When we preserve route, we must forward a sampling tag so dashboards can attribute traces without leaking PII. Propose `X-RD-Route-Hash` (sha256 shortened).
rob: Proposal summary: proxy preserves `X-RD-Route-Hash` on fallback; SDKs expose opt-in boolean `preserve_route_fallback` (false by default); console/back-end maintains a lookup mapping route-hash -> tenant for aggregation.
maya: +1 to that. Can we make the hash deterministic and rotateable? Need to support key rotation for privacy.
kevin: Yes — we'll HMAC with a server-side key and include key-version header like `X-RD-Route-Key: v2` so backend can rehydrate safely. No plaintext route data travels.
ellie: UX ask: Console should show trace note: "Request fallbacked to model XYZ — attribution carried from tenant ABC via route-hash" in the trace details. Also add a metrics filter for fallback-attributed traffic.
sanjay: I'll update quota ledger to accept `route_hash` for aggregation and add a migration plan to backfill last 7 days where possible.
rob: Test plan: unit tests + end-to-end with console lookup table; ensure no PII in logs or telemetry. Add automated smoke for billing dashboards.
maya: Timeline? Can we canary next week in non-prod?
kevin: I'll open PRs for python/ts/go SDKs today. Default remains false; docs and changelog will call out opt-in.
ellie: I'll add a console feature flag and a gradual rollout plan (10% orgs -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks) and wire an audit log for when orgs enable preserve-route.
sanjay: I'll own backend changes + ledger patch. Estimated 3 sprints for rollout (backend + console + SDKs).
rob: Quick note: remember to update our telemetry schema and kafka topic docs so downstream analytics teams aren't surprised.
maya: Great. I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed 10am to align owners. @kevin @sanjay please link PRs in the thread when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to canary cluster at 2024-08-14T02:00Z (canary, non-prod)
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
